title: SC to hear on Dec 9 pleas alleging irregularities in SIR of electoral rolls
description:
The Supreme Court on Tuesday said it would hear on December 9 a batch of pleas, including the one filed by Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and other INDIA bloc leaders, alleging large-scale voter deletions and irregularities in SIR of electoral rolls.
A bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana, which was scheduled to hear the petitions during the day, adjourned the hearing as a part-heard matter would be taken up in the post-lunch session.
The CJI said a special bench would also assemble at 3.30 pm to hear another matter.
Senior advocate Kapil Sibal referred to an application filed by Gandhi and other INDIA bloc leaders seeking a nod to put 48 written questions to the Election Commission on the decision-making process in the nationwide special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
"We are asking for some interrogatories from the Election Commission. In the meantime, they may respond to it," Sibal said.
